states.label: Pending
states.explanation: Created per order item when the order is confirmed (0.5% from ₹2,500 for buyers, 2% from ₹800 for members, rounded up), or per creator after the monthly reward pool settlement.

states.label: Available
states.explanation: Spent oldest-expiry first at checkout or for membership. Creators can cash out from 250 Electrons (1 Electron = ₹1), paid weekly.

transitions.label: return window closed
transitions.note: hourly job; creator pool lots on the next run

transitions.label: 12 months passed
transitions.note: daily job; reminders 30 and 7 days before

transitions.label: restored
transitions.note: refund, failed payment or failed payout; keeps original expiry

cards.title: Ledger
items: Append-only ledger_entries; balances are derived, never edited
Each spend records which lots it used (spend_allocations)

cards.title: Balances
items: Nightly check: ledger sum matches balances

cards.title: Edge case
items: Electrons restored after their lot expired are re-issued for 30 days (configurable)
